public_input_fields.Dynamic_Profile: initial profile state; later sessions update it in dialogue
public_input_fields.Fixed_Profile: profile known before the interaction begins
public_input_fields.Full_Session_Chain[].Date: session date, the only timestamp a product may stamp
public_input_fields.Full_Session_Chain[].Session_Dialogue: the conversation itself; the ingestion surface
public_input_fields.ID: persona identifier, needed to isolate one run per persona
public_input_fields.Others_Profile: third-party profiles the dialogue refers to

rule: no scorer-only field may enter product writes, query text, metadata, ranking or filters

scorer_only_fields.Full_Session_Chain[].Revealed_Attributes: construction metadata for the initial reveal
scorer_only_fields.Full_Session_Chain[].Session_Questions[]: conflict label; upstream gives it to the scorer, not to the system
scorer_only_fields.Full_Session_Chain[].Session_Type: construction label naming the session's role
